UP STF Report on Religious Conversion Activities at KGMU Lucknow

An Uttar Pradesh Special Task Force (STF) investigation has uncovered alleged religious conversion activities at King George's Medical University (KGMU) in Lucknow. The STF report reportedly found collusion among Muslim faculty members involved in these activities. The Yogi government has directed action against those accused based on the findings. Navbharat Times reported that officials had been concealing complaints related to the matter, which were revealed during the STF investigation.
